scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "[BuildIQ] pnpm not detected — installing pnpm globally then running pnpm install..." >&2; npm install -g pnpm --prefer-offline 2>/dev/null || true; pnpm install --shamefully-hoist; exit 0 ;; esac'
scripts.build: BASE_PATH=/ NODE_ENV=production pnpm --filter @workspace/vonios-remontas run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
